title: Mega Menu List
description: The query-driven link column inside a mega-menu panel — the tour and special lists that sit beside the navigation columns. Row height comes from settings.custom.mega-menu.row-padding in theme.json, shared with the navigation column so the two lists keep one rhythm. Carries the resting row contract: flush rows and body type at the navigation row's weight and rhythm, so a query row and a navigation row read as one list. Rows carry no divider — a neutral-300 `border-bottom` sat on every `> li` until 2026-09-18 and was removed on Zared's instruction, in the same change that took the hairline off the navigation half. This is the counterpart to styles/blocks/navigation/mega-menu-nav.json; the two describe the same row on different markup and have to be changed together. The `width:100%` on the post-template is what makes the rows span the column: the query block carries a vertical flex layout, which core compiles to `.wp-container-core-query-is-layout-‹hash›{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}` — so without it the rows, and any full-width treatment on them, are only as wide as the longest title. Hover and :focus-visible cannot live in this file's css field — WordPress strips :hover out of it entirely — so they sit in assets/styles/ollie-mega-menu.css alongside the navigation half.
